lines.label: viscoelastic joints (passive)
lines.note: always on; stiffness and damping per joint

lines.label: proprioceptive sensing
lines.note: timescale = sensory delay (s); ignites when a joint velocity exceeds the threshold (rad/s)

lines.label: vestibular / head-motion sensing
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on trunk tilt rate (rad/s)

lines.label: visual feedback
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on a visible COM offset (m); can be blocked

lines.label: tactile / contact-pressure sensing
lines.note: timescale = delay; ignites on a centre-of-pressure shift (m)

lines.label: cue perception
lines.note: timescale = delay; the movement / direction-change cues are sensed through it

lines.label: local joint reflex
lines.note: timescale = loop latency; ignites on a fast sensed joint motion

lines.label: central balance command (ankle)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a sensed COM offset from the reference

lines.label: central balance command (hip)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a large COM offset

lines.label: central movement command (feed-forward)
lines.note: timescale = latency; ignites on a sensed cue

lines.label: tonic co-contraction (core)
lines.note: baseline co-contraction level; costs energy while on

lines.label: breathing cycle
lines.note: timescale = period (s); modulates trunk drive and chest motion

lines.label: energy supply / fatigue
lines.note: timescale = fatigue time constant (s); internal, no observation model sees it directly

lines.label: gain adaptation
lines.note: timescale = adaptation time constant (s); slow retained state
